purpose: Frozen extraction contract for the live 77-class XGBoost model: the 252 inputs in schema order, their definitions, NaN rules and the owner decisions. Steps 2-6 (Python reference, export, Rust loader, extractor, window) implement it. Parity with this contract is not parity with the publisher.
label: Live XGBoost (77-class, 10 s windows)
provenance_note: Trained on DataSense windows of 1-10 s; scored here on 10 s windows; not yet validated on real traffic on this PC. Validation results are from the dataset, the held-out test was not used.

provenance_review.rule: label and provenance_note are copied verbatim from the decisions file

artifacts/training/upgrades2_live_202611.value_sha256_rule: sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)), the file's own 'sha256' field (arms._sha); the integration plan quotes this one

feature_names_sha256_rule: sha256 of the names joined by '\n' (same as selection.json)

window.display: show each 10 s verdict as it completes

gate.rule: a window is scored only when its measured duration is within 10 +/- 1 s (the existing Window::counts gate, packet.rs:470); plan step 6 keeps it

window.decision: owner, 3 Nov 2026 (changed from 1 s): use 10 s windows, which match the app's existing capture window and are a length the dataset contains and the model was trained on
window.supersedes: integration plan text for a 1 s window (window_seconds 1, nominal 1.0, 1 s period, 1.0 s gate)
window.note: 10 s rows are 20,688 of 384,214 fit rows. validation_by_length is copied from window.json: the final model on the validation tuning role (used for tuning, so optimistic), restricted to the 40 classes present at every length, before the class merge; the held-out test was not used.

admission.capture_filter: ether host <device MAC> (IPv6 removed in software); snaplen 192; no payload saved

damaged_window.rule: keep the current rule: features that cannot be measured reliably (capture drops, unreadable headers) are blank (missing)

family_damage.ipv4_header: an unreadable or truncated IPv4 header, or an incomplete link layer, makes the IPv4 statistics and fragmented-packets missing
family_damage.ipv4_or_arp_header: as ipv4_header, or an unreadable ARP body, makes the ips counts missing
family_damage.tcp_header: a truncated TCP header makes the tcp-flags/window-size statistics and flag counts missing
family_damage.tcp_options: a truncated TCP header or malformed TCP options makes the mss statistics missing
family_damage.ports: a TCP/UDP header whose ports cannot be read makes absent port presence missing

damaged_window.not_damage: non-initial IPv4 fragments, non-IP frames, IPv6 frames (excluded) and options-free TCP
damaged_window.status_note: capture drop: the current rule nulls every feature and skips the window (features.rs:567-587, packet.rs:478). family_damage maps the current per-family voiding onto the 252 inputs; the owner has not reviewed that mapping.

shap_after_merge: when the merged decision is recon_scan, show exact TreeSHAP for BOTH recon_scan and recon_ping-sweep side by side, with a note that ping-sweep probability was merged into recon scan; otherwise explain the decided class

pending_owner_signoff.blocks: plan step 5 (extractor) is not frozen until the owner signs these off

definitions.count.frames: number of admitted frames (all) / sent by the device MAC (src) / the rest (dst)
definitions.count.tcp_flag: admitted TCP segments (IPv4, readable TCP header) with (flags & mask) != 0
definitions.distinct.ipv4_with_arp: distinct IPv4 addresses from IPv4 headers plus ARP sender/target protocol addresses
definitions.distinct.mac: distinct Ethernet MAC addresses of admitted frames
definitions.stat.tcp.mss_option: MSS option value (kind 2, length 4) of TCP segments that carry it
definitions.presence.port: TCP/UDP header port of that direction among the kept ports
definitions.presence.port_unseen: a kept port of that direction outside the 96-port vocabulary

nan_rules.global_only: never NaN except in a capture-drop window (all 252 missing, not scored)
nan_rules.family_count: count (0 in a zero-packet window); NaN when its damage_family is damaged in the window
nan_rules.family_stat: NaN when packets_all == 0; 0 when packets_all > 0 and the family has no values; NaN when its damage_family is damaged; otherwise the statistic
nan_rules.ratio: NaN when the denominator is 0 or missing, or the numerator is missing
nan_rules.port_presence: 1 when kept; else NaN when that direction is capped (> 1000 distinct) or ports are damaged; else 0
nan_rules.port_unseen: 1 when a kept port is outside the vocabulary (always so in a capped direction); else NaN when ports are damaged; else 0

empty_family_zero.rule: tcp-flags/window-size/mss and ttl/ip-length/header-length/ip-flags statistics are 0 (not NaN) when the window has packets but none of that family; NaN only when packets_all == 0
empty_family_zero.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): with packets_all > 0 (29,965 rows) none of the 7 summary families is NaN; all-zero rows: header-length 3,026, ip-flags 10,141, ip-length 3,026, mss 22,039, tcp-flags 9,581, ttl 3,026, window-size 9,501.

mss_bearing_only.rule: mss statistics use MSS-bearing TCP packets only; a packet without the option adds nothing; 0 when no packet carries the option and packets_all > 0 (empty_family_zero)
mss_bearing_only.replaces: mss_absent_zero ('a TCP packet without an MSS option contributes mss 0'), contradicted by the data
mss_bearing_only.evidence: the 384,214 fit77 training rows the final model was fit on: 0 of 84,493 rows with mss_max > 0 have mss_min == 0 (0 found), and 0 have syn == 0 with mss_max > 0. 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): 0 of 7,926; 1 row has syn == 0 with mss_max > 0 (an MSS option outside a SYN; the rule keys on the option, not on SYN).
mss_bearing_only.decision: MSS statistics over MSS-bearing packets only; 0 when none carry the option and packets > 0 (correct the EMULATION note mss_absent_zero)

fragment_mf_only.rule: fragmented-packets counts packets with the IP MF bit set (not offset-only last fragments)
fragment_mf_only.unknown: publisher definition (MF-only vs MF-or-offset) cannot be settled from CSV rows

fragments_keep_stats.rule: non-initial fragments must not void TCP statistics or port presence for the window; a non-initial fragment adds its IPv4 header statistics and no transport values
fragments_keep_stats.source: live77.EMULATION (2026-10-31 review) and integration plan steps 2 and 5; not in the decisions file

arp_ips.rule: ARP sender/target IPv4 addresses count in ips_* sets and packets_per_reported_ip
arp_ips.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): all 2,347 of 2,347 windows whose only protocol is ARP report IPv4 addresses (ips_all_count > 0), so ARP addresses are counted.

arp_ip_direction.rule: the ARP sender protocol address counts as src and the target protocol address as dst; 0.0.0.0 (ARP probe sender) is counted literally
arp_ip_direction.evidence_note: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): in 317 ARP-only windows the device only sent, ips src/dst counts are 1/1 in 312, 1/2 in 5 windows, consistent with a directional sender/target mapping but not proof of which side is src; 0.0.0.0 appears in 0 ARP-only windows and in 17 windows overall
arp_ip_direction.unknown: publisher ARP direction and its handling of 0.0.0.0 probes

port_cap_1000.rule: per direction, the first 1000 distinct ports in arrival order are kept; once more than 1000 are seen, port presence is 1 for kept vocabulary ports and NaN otherwise (dataset lists are capped at 1000); later ports set nothing; listed_distinct is clamped at 1000 per direction; descriptors on capped lists stay approximate
port_cap_1000.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): presence is NaN exactly when the reported port count differs from the listed count (3,712 src / 2,447 dst rows), then 1 for listed vocabulary ports and NaN otherwise (0 + 0 mismatches); lists never exceed 1000 ports.
port_cap_1000.decision: keep the first 1000 distinct ports per direction in arrival order; later ports do not set port features
port_cap_1000.unknown: which 1000 ports the publisher exporter keeps

port_unseen.rule: UNSEEN is 1 when a kept port of that direction is outside the 96-port vocabulary of that direction (port_vocabulary below); a capped direction keeps 1000 ports, at most 96 of them in the vocabulary, so UNSEEN is 1 there
port_unseen.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): UNSEEN recomputed from the raw lists against the 96-port vocabularies: 0 + 0 mismatches, 0 + 0 NaN; UNSEEN is 1 in all 3,712 src and 2,447 dst capped rows.

tcp_flags_12bit.rule: tcp-flags statistics use the 12-bit field including the reserved bits ((tcp[12] & 0x0f) << 8 | tcp[13]); training rows reach 2242
tcp_flags_12bit.evidence: the 384,214 fit77 training rows the final model was fit on: tcp-flags_max > 511 in 705 rows, max 2242. 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): max 152 (0 rows above 511).
tcp_flags_12bit.decision: 12-bit field including the 3 reserved bits (data max 2242)
tcp_flags_12bit.unknown: semantics of the reserved bits in the publisher exporter

population_std.rule: std_deviation is the population standard deviation (ddof=0)
population_std.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): in rows with 2 packets, distinct min/max and avg at the midpoint, std/(max-min) is exactly 0.5 (population), never 0.7071 (sample): ttl 1,185/1,185, ip-length 1,193/1,193, window-size 1,176/1,176, tcp-flags 1,158/1,158, ip-flags 1,122/1,122.

header_direction.rule: src/dst of ips, macs and ports are the header source/destination fields of each admitted frame, independent of the device's packet direction; all is the union of src and dst
header_direction.evidence_note: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): macs_src holds a MAC other than the device MAC in 26,741 rows, so the MAC sets are header fields of all admitted frames; ips and ports are assumed to follow the same rule

device_mac_admission.rule: a frame is admitted when its Ethernet source or destination MAC equals the device MAC
device_mac_admission.decision: device MAC address only (as the dataset)

device_mac_packet_direction.rule: packets_src counts admitted frames whose source MAC is the device MAC, packets_dst the rest, so packets_all = packets_src + packets_dst
device_mac_packet_direction.evidence_note: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): packets_all == packets_src + packets_dst in 30,000 rows; which side is the device's own frames is inferred, not verified

broadcast_not_admitted.rule: received broadcast/multicast frames that do not carry the device MAC are not admitted (literal reading of 'device MAC address only')
broadcast_not_admitted.unknown: whether the publisher also counted received broadcast/multicast frames

all_frames_counted.rule: every admitted frame counts in packets and macs, including non-IP frames such as LLDP; the capture filter is widened to the device MAC accordingly; payloads are never saved
all_frames_counted.decision: count all frames for that MAC, including non-IP frames such as LLDP; widen the capture filter accordingly

ipv6_excluded.rule: IPv6 frames are left out of the model window entirely (no packets, macs, ports or statistics)
ipv6_excluded.decision: leave IPv6 frames out of the model window
ipv6_excluded.evidence_note: the training lists contain no IPv6 addresses (integration plan)

nominal_duration.rule: window_duration_seconds = 10; per_second = count / 10 (the nominal duration); the measured duration only gates the window (10 +/- 1 s)
nominal_duration.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): window_duration_seconds is always an integer in 1..10 (1,571 rows of length 10) and per_second == count / window_duration_seconds exactly in float32 (30,000 rows).
nominal_duration.decision: every 10 s tumbling window is scored; window_duration_seconds = 10 and per_second features = count / 10 (the nominal duration), as in the dataset rows of length 10

zero_packet_window_scored.rule: a window with no admitted frame is scored: counts 0, per_second 0, quality_no_packets_observed 1, statistics and ratios NaN, port presence and UNSEEN 0
zero_packet_window_scored.evidence: 30,000 validation-partition rows of csv_v3_cascade_20261030_v1 (held-out test not opened): all 35 zero-packet rows follow exactly this pattern, and the quality flag is 0 in every other row.
zero_packet_window_scored.decision: owner, 4 Nov 2026 (changed): a window with no packets from the device is NOT scored. Show 'No traffic in this window' with no verdict and model_executed false (option A). Reason: an empty 10 s window scored as mitm_impersonation 0.559, a false alert every 10 s on an idle PC.
